name.text: Using a Distance-time graph to find average rate of change

questiontext.text:
The graph below shows the distance \(d\), in kilometres, travelled by a vehicle over time \(t\), in hours. The graph passes through the points \(A({@t1@},{@d1@})\), \(B({@t2@},{@d2@})\) and \(C({@t3@},{@d3@})\).

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ans3="ref_pA" input-ref-ans4="ref_pB" input-ref-ans5="ref_pC" width="540px" height="540px"]] var T1={#t1#}, T2={#t2#}, T3={#t3#}, D1={#d1#}, D2={#d2#}, D3={#d3#}; var XMIN={#float(xminv)#}, XMAX={#float(xmaxv)#}, YMAX={#float(ymaxv)#}, YMIN={#float(yminv)#}; var DLO={#float(dlo)#}, DHI={#float(dhi)#}; function dfun(t){ return D1*(t-T2)*(t-T3)/((T1-T2)*(T1-T3)) + D2*(t-T1)*(t-T3)/((T2-T1)*(T2-T3)) + D3*(t-T1)*(t-T2)/((T3-T1)*(T3-T2)); } var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, {boundingbox:[XMIN, YMAX, XMAX, YMIN], axis:true, showCopyright:false, showNavigation:false, grid:true, keepaspectratio:false}); brd.defaultAxes.x.setAttribute({ticks:{majorHeight:8, drawLabels:true, label:{fontSize:11}}}); brd.defaultAxes.y.setAttribute({ticks:{majorHeight:8, drawLabels:true, label:{fontSize:11}}}); brd.create('text',[XMAX-0.15, 0.6, 't (hours)'],{anchorX:'right',fixed:true,fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#333'}); brd.create('text',[0.35, YMAX-0.15, 'd (km)'],{anchorX:'left',fixed:true,fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#333'}); brd.create('functiongraph', [dfun, DLO, DHI], {strokeColor:'#1f4fd8', strokeWidth:2.5, highlight:false}); brd.create('point',[T1,D1],{name:'A',fixed:true,color:'#1f4fd8',fillColor:'#1f4fd8',size:4,label:{offset:[-16,8],fontSize:16,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#1f4fd8'}}); brd.create('point',[T2,D2],{name:'B',fixed:true,color:'#1f4fd8',fillColor:'#1f4fd8',size:4,label:{offset:[-16,8],fontSize:16,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#1f4fd8'}}); brd.create('point',[T3,D3],{name:'C',fixed:true,color:'#1f4fd8',fillColor:'#1f4fd8',size:4,label:{offset:[-16,8],fontSize:16,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#1f4fd8'}}); var p1 = brd.create('point',[T1,0],{name:'1',color:'#cc0000',fillColor:'#cc0000',size:5,snapToGrid:true,snapSizeX:1,snapSizeY:1,label:{offset:[8,0],fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#cc0000'}}); var p2 = brd.create('point',[T2,0],{name:'2',color:'#cc0000',fillColor:'#cc0000',size:5,snapToGrid:true,snapSizeX:1,snapSizeY:1,label:{offset:[8,0],fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#cc0000'}}); var p3 = brd.create('point',[T3,0],{name:'3',color:'#cc0000',fillColor:'#cc0000',size:5,snapToGrid:true,snapSizeX:1,snapSizeY:1,label:{offset:[8,0],fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#cc0000'}}); brd.create('segment',[p1,p2],{strokeColor:'#cc0000',strokeWidth:2}); brd.create('segment',[p2,p3],{strokeColor:'#cc0000',strokeWidth:2}); stack_jxg.bind_point(ref_pA, p1); stack_jxg.bind_point(ref_pB, p2); stack_jxg.bind_point(ref_pC, p3); [[/jsxgraph]]
[[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]] [[input:ans4]] [[validation:ans4]] [[input:ans5]] [[validation:ans5]]

a) Calculate the average rate of change of distance (in km/h) between:

i. \(t={@t1@}\) and \(t={@t2@}\): [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]
ii. \(t={@t2@}\) and \(t={@t3@}\): [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

b) Draw the two secant lines on the graph above: drag the three red points onto \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\). The middle point is shared by both secants, so place it on \(B\).

[[feedback:prt3]]

c) Which interval has the greater average rate of change?

[[input:ansc]] [[validation:ansc]] [[feedback:prt4]]

generalfeedback.text:
a) The average rate of change over an interval is \(\dfrac{\text{change in distance}}{\text{change in time}}\).

\[ \text{i. } \frac{{@d2@}-{@d1@}}{{@t2@}-{@t1@}} = \frac{{@d2-d1@}}{{@t2-t1@}} = {@r1@}\text{ km/h}, \qquad \text{ii. } \frac{{@d3@}-{@d2@}}{{@t3@}-{@t2@}} = \frac{{@d3-d2@}}{{@t3-t2@}} = {@r2@}\text{ km/h}. \]

b) The first secant joins \(A\) and \(B\); the second joins \(B\) and \(C\). The gradient of each secant equals the average rate of change on that interval. The two secants are shown in red below.

[[jsxgraph width="470px" height="470px"]] var T1={#t1#}, T2={#t2#}, T3={#t3#}, D1={#d1#}, D2={#d2#}, D3={#d3#}; var XMIN={#float(xminv)#}, XMAX={#float(xmaxv)#}, YMAX={#float(ymaxv)#}, YMIN={#float(yminv)#}; var DLO={#float(dlo)#}, DHI={#float(dhi)#}; function dfun(t){ return D1*(t-T2)*(t-T3)/((T1-T2)*(T1-T3)) + D2*(t-T1)*(t-T3)/((T2-T1)*(T2-T3)) + D3*(t-T1)*(t-T2)/((T3-T1)*(T3-T2)); } var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, {boundingbox:[XMIN, YMAX, XMAX, YMIN], axis:true, showCopyright:false, showNavigation:false, grid:true, keepaspectratio:false}); brd.create('text',[XMAX-0.15, 0.6, 't (hours)'],{anchorX:'right',fixed:true,fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#333'}); brd.create('text',[0.35, YMAX-0.15, 'd (km)'],{anchorX:'left',fixed:true,fontSize:14,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#333'}); brd.create('functiongraph', [dfun, DLO, DHI], {strokeColor:'#1f4fd8', strokeWidth:2.5, highlight:false}); brd.create('segment',[[T1,D1],[T2,D2]],{strokeColor:'#cc0000',strokeWidth:2.5}); brd.create('segment',[[T2,D2],[T3,D3]],{strokeColor:'#cc0000',strokeWidth:2.5}); brd.create('point',[T1,D1],{name:'A',fixed:true,color:'#1f4fd8',fillColor:'#1f4fd8',size:4,label:{offset:[-16,8],fontSize:16,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#1f4fd8'}}); brd.create('point',[T2,D2],{name:'B',fixed:true,color:'#1f4fd8',fillColor:'#1f4fd8',size:4,label:{offset:[-16,8],fontSize:16,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#1f4fd8'}}); brd.create('point',[T3,D3],{name:'C',fixed:true,color:'#1f4fd8',fillColor:'#1f4fd8',size:4,label:{offset:[-16,8],fontSize:16,cssStyle:'font-weight:bold;color:#1f4fd8'}}); [[/jsxgraph]]

c) The interval \({@clabel@}\) has the greater average rate of change (\({@rmax@}\) km/h versus \({@rmin@}\) km/h).

truefeedback.text: You divided the change in time by the change in distance. Average rate \(=\dfrac{\text{change in distance}}{\text{change in time}}\).
